title: Neuraxial Pethidine After Lumbar Surgery Trial
brief_summary: The hypothesis is that epidural pethidine is an effective form of pain relief following lumbar spinal surgery, resulting in significantly lower usage of concomitantly administered (intravenous) patient-controlled analgesia (PCA) pethidine.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Adults undergoing lumbar spinal surgery

Exclusion Criteria:

* Lack of informed patient consent
* Acute or chronic renal failure
* Known allergy or intolerance to pethidine or tramadol
* Chronic respiratory insufficiency
* Epidural contraindicated (coagulopathy, systemic infection)
